text:
maria: Heads-up — we have 4 repaired nodes (gpu-az1-08..11) coming back from bench. I want to run a holdout validation/soak before rejoining cluster. Proposed workflow:

maria: - 24h continuous CUDA stress (memtest + compute)
- 6h model-inference loop (mini LLM runs) with streaming
- monitor ECC increments, Xid counts, dmesg/kernel oops
- mark PASS if no new ECC/Xid and stable temps < 78C and 0 reboots

alex: +1. How strict on Xid? A single new Xid should fail us right?

tyler: I'd say any new Xid >= 1 during soak = fail. ECC correctable increments also fail if delta > 0. Uncorrectable obviously hard fail.

sam: Adding logs to S3 path and perf counters. Also capture `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ECC` and nv-hostengine logs.

jordan: We should run this script:
```bash
# run approx stress + inference loop
./tools/gpu_soak/run_soak.sh --duration 24h --model small-llama --inference-iter 1000 --memtest --log-s3 s3://redwood-gpu-soak/returns/$NODE
```

maria: Nice. Make sure run_soak collects dmesg every 10m, and autosnap gpu health dump every 15m.

tyler: Also include a power-cycle test after 12h if node still green to catch flaky power issues.

oncall-bot: reminder — schedule maintenance window and update #fleet-ops when nodes go offline/online :calendar:

alex: Where do we store pass/fail? We need a canonical ticket in JIRA. I'll create INF-4721 and attach soak logs.

maria: tl;dr checklist:
- start soak via run_soak.sh
- monitor ECC/Xid (fail on any new Xid or ECC delta>0)
- temp limit 78C
- run power cycle halfway
- attach logs to INF-4721
- only rejoin once ticket marked PASSED

sam: I'll spin up the soak runners and start at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. Will ping here when started.

jordan: If any nodes fail, we should mark them for RMA; don't attempt reimage until we reproduce on bench.

sam: started: 1779001300
maria: noted. thanks team :thumbsup:
